none: PAS NLM-F71229: Roman Coin: Radiate of Victorinus
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP C VICT [----] ; R/ SIDNS MI LIT[VM]

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Victorinus (269-271), cf. Cunetio no. 2515, Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP C VICT [----]. Reverse description: Fides standing left with standards. Reverse inscription: SIDNS MI LIT[VM], presumably error for FIDES. Diameter: 18.6mm, Weight: 1.58gms, die axis: 6
